content: Moses Pwurehng ale Kosonned akan
“KAUN-O eri mahsanihong ie, ‘Wiahda pelien takai riapali duwehte mehn mahs ako, ke ahpw kohdahdo pohn nahnaht. Pil wiahda ehu kohpwa tuhkehn.
I pahn ntingihediong pohn takai riapalien mahsen ko me mi pohn pelien takai riapalien mahs ako me ke kauwelahr; ke ahpw pahn koasoanediong nan kohpwahn.’
“Ngehi eri wiahda kohpwa ieu sang tuhke akesia, oh siselehda pelien takai riapali duwehte mehn mahs ako, I ahpw kohdahla pohn nahnao wa pelien takai riapalio.

KAUN-O eri ketin intingihedi pohn pelien takai riapalio duwen me e ketin ntingihedi pohn pelien takai riapalien mahs ako, Kosonned Eiseko me e ketin poahngokihong kumwail pohn nahnao sang nan mpwulen kisinieio ni rahnen pokon lapalapo; e ahpw ketikihong ie.
I ahpw pwuredihsang pohn nahnao oh kihdiong nan kohpwa me I wiadahro pelien takai riapalio, duwen KAUN-O eh ketin mahsanihong ie; oh re mihmihte wasao lel ahnsou wet.” (
Mehn Israel ko eri mweselsang pwarer kan en Sahkan, mwesellahng Mosera. Wasao Aaron ahpw sipalla oh seridi ie, a nah pwutak Eleasar ahpw wiliandi nan dewen samworo.
Sang wasao re ahpw inenlahng Kudkoda, oh sang Kudkoda re kohdilahng Sotpada, wasa kisin piletik kei mi ie.

Eri, ni ahnsowo KAUN-O ahpw ketin koasoanehdi pwe kadaudok en Lipai en pwukoahki apwahpwalih Kohpwahn Inowo, oh papah nin duwen samworo kei, oh wia kapaiamwahu kan ni mwaren KAUN-O, duwen me kin wiewiawi kohdo lel rahnwet.
Ih kahrepen kadaudok en Lipai ar sohte iang sapwasapw duwehte kadaudok teikan. Pwe arail sohso, iei re en wia samworo en KAUN-O, duwen KAUN-O, amwail Koht, e ketin inoukihda.)
“I mihmihki pohn nahnao erein rahn pahisek oh pwohng pahisek, duwehte me I wiahier mahso. KAUN-O eri pil ketin karonge ei pekipek ahnsowo, oh kupwurehda en dehr ketin kamwomwkumwailla.
E ahpw mahsanihong ie, ‘Eri, met, mwesel oh kohwei mwohn noumw aramas akan oh kahluwa irail pwe re en kak pedolong oh sapwenikihla sahpw me I inoukihong arail pahpa kahlap ako me I pahn kihong irail.
Dahme KAUN-O Kupwurki sang rehn Sapwellime kan

“Eri met, kumwail mehn Israel, kumwail rong dahme KAUN-O, amwail Koht, ketin kupwurki sang rehmwail. Kumwail en lemmwiki KAUN-O oh kapwaiada sapwellime mahsen koaros. Poakohng ih oh papah ni mohngiongimwail unsek.
Kapwaiada sapwellime kosonned koaros me I kehkehlingkihong kumwail rahnwet pwe kumwail en nsenamwahu.
KAUN-O me sapwellimaniki pahnlahng oh sampah oh pil audepe kan koaros.
Pwehki KAUN-O eh ketin loaloale mehlel amwail pahpa kahlap ako, ihme e ketin pilkinkumwailda, e ahpw sohte ketin pilada aramas teikan, oh kumwail wialahr sapwellime aramas pilipil kei lel rahnwet.
Eri, sang met kohla kumwail peikiong KAUN-O oh tokedihsang amwail keptakai.

KAUN-O, amwail Koht, me ketin lapalapasang koht akan koaros oh manaman koaros. Ih me Wasa Lapalahpie oh roson; eri mehkoaros en peikiong ih. E sohte kin ketin lipilipilki aramas oh e sohte kin ketin uhpalihki me sapwung.
E kin ketin koasoanehdi pwuhng ong me sepwoupwou kan oh ong liohdi kan; e kin ketin poakohng mehn liki kan me koukousoan rehn atail aramas akan oh e kin ketin katungoale oh kalikawih irail.
Eri, kumwail pil kasalehda amwail poakohng mehn liki kan, pwe kumwail pil wia mehn liki mahso nan Isip.
Kumwail lemmwiki KAUN-O, amwail Koht, oh kaudokiong ihete. Loalopwoat ong ih oh kahula ni mwarehte.
Kapinga ih—ih me amwail Koht, oh kumwail pein kilangki masamwail kan sapwellime wiewia lapalap oh kapwuriamwei me e ketin wiahiong kumwail.
Ni amwail pahpa kahlap ako arail kohdilahng Isip, irail mehte isiakan, ahpw met KAUN-O, amwail Koht, ketin kahngedereikumwaillahr duwehte usuhn pahnlahng kan.”
